abstract: A 43-year-old men presented with left supraclavicular growing mass. Ultrasonography revealed a 31 x 21 mm solid mass with a homogeneous echoic pattern. Lymph node metastasis of some malignant neoplasms was highly suspected. However, whole body evaluation with computed tomographic scan revealed no findings in the primary region. In addition, tumor markers including alpha fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin and carcinoembryonic antigen were within normal limits. Then, extirpation of supraclavicular mass was performed and pathological diagnosis was made as pure seminoma. Evaluation of testicle by ultrasonography revealed a diffuse calcification. However, histological examination of biopsy specimen of testicle revealed no malignancy. The mass was finally diagnosed as extragonadal or "burned-out" pure seminoma. The patient received two courses of Peplomycin, vinblastine and cisplatin (PVP) therapy, and there has been no evidence of recurrence for 34 months.
abstract_ja: 43歳男性が、左鎖骨上窩の増大する腫瘤を主訴に受診した。超音波検査で31×21mmの均一なエコー輝度を示す充実性腫瘤を認めた。何らかの悪性腫瘍のリンパ節転移が強く疑われた。しかし、全身CT検査では原発巣に所見はなかった。さらに、αフェトプロテイン、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、CEAを含む腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内であった。そこで鎖骨上窩の腫瘤を摘出したところ、病理学的診断は純粋セミノーマであった。精巣の超音波検査ではびまん性石灰化を認めた。しかし、精巣生検標本の病理組織学的検査では悪性所見はなかった。腫瘤は最終的に性腺外または「燃え尽き型」の純粋セミノーマと診断された。患者はペプロマイシン、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチン(PVP)療法を2コース受け、34か月間再発の証拠はない。
